fast_cache_semantic_justification: The in-memory key is compact because each Julia worker owns a fresh cache pair for one ticker, fixed score/stage contracts, one Repository V2 daily/context input, completed-week semantics, and include_incomplete_periods=false. Persistent reuse additionally validates contract, implementation, source-data, and runtime fingerprints before loading.
monthly_cache_semantic_justification: Monthly snapshots are always requested with the same ticker-local Repository V2 context and include_incomplete_periods=false. A different requested month is a different key; a different scope requires a new cache instance.
exclusion_justification: These inputs do not affect evaluate_pattern_a_fast or the monthly Pattern A snapshot; eligibility remains downstream and is evaluated independently per strategy path.
cache_ownership: ticker-local worker pair; no cross-ticker mutable cache sharing
stale_cache_policy: PersistentFeatureCacheStore rejects version/source/runtime mismatch as a cold start
